description.value:
You hurl a splinter of cryogenic energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d10 kinetic damage. Whether the attack hits or misses, the splinter then detonates, and the target along with each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 cold damage.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the cold damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
